Hi Samantha / Tom 1

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call + agreed next steps so we all have the same plan. Please reply if I missed anything.

Summary of pain / goals you shared:
- User-facing search latency spikes during peak windows (esp. morning batch from East Coast).
- Need consistent 95th percentile generation latency below ~250ms for typical prompts (~512 tokens) for search re-rank and short completion flows.
- Sustained throughput target: ~40 requests/sec (avg request size ~350 tokens) with burst capacity to 120 rps for short windows.
- Cost sensitivity: want to avoid constantly running the largest model for all traffic.
- Data residency: model inference must run in your VPC (private deployment) for PII-sensitive logs.

Model & infra requirements we discussed:
- Primary model: Llama-2-70B (quantized 4-bit), with a smaller fallback model (Redwood-verified 13B quantized) for degraded load.
- KV caching for hot prefixes to eliminate redundant token compute on repeat queries.
- Autoscaling on dedicated GPU pool in us-west with cross-region failover to us-east for DR.
- Canaries for rollout + automatic fallback to hosted endpoint in case of capacity pressure.

SLO targets we sketched:
- P50: <80ms (in-region, cached where applicable)
- P95: <=250ms for 512-token inference
- P99: <=600ms (with graceful degradation to 13B model)
- Throughput: baseline 40 rps sustained, 120 rps burst for <5 min windows

Open / action items:
1) Dev to share approximate QPS distribution and token-length histogram (you said you'll export last 30 days) 1 Samantha/Tom
2) Redwood to produce a recommended deployment topology and cost estimate (infra diagram + SLO-cost tradeoffs) 1 Marissa / Dev (attached: draft infra diagram + initial SLO worksheet)
3) Schedule on-site / remote proof-of-concept (4-week POC) and agree metrics for success (latency, cost-per-inference, error rate) 1 Rachel to coordinate schedule

Attachments: acme_infra_diagram.pdf (draft), slo_summary.xlsx (initial SLO worksheet)

Next meetings:
- POC kickoff: week of May 25 (Rachel to propose times)
- Architecture sync (technical): May 14, 10am PT (tentative)

Thanks 1 appreciate the clarity on priorities.

Best,

Hi Samantha / Tom 1

Thanks for the QPS and token distribution confirm. A couple notes from a technical viability and deployment standpoint:

1) Topology recommendation (initial POC):
- Dedicated Redwood Private deployment in your VPC (us-west-2) with a reserved pool of 4x H100-class GPUs (auto-scale policy to add 2 GPUs on sustained 60s CPU/GPU queue depth threshold).
- KV prefix caching layer in front of model instances (best-case reduce token compute by ~25–35% for your workload pattern).
- Load router that sends 85% traffic to Llama-2-70B quantized instances, 15% to 13B fallback under normal conditions; under high queue depth the router will increase fallback to 40% before we scale up.
- Cross-region DR: warm standby in us-east with periodic KV sync; failover policy is automated and tested during canary run.

2) Latency & throughput expectations (POC config above):
- P50: ~60–90ms (cached paths significantly faster)
- P95: 180–260ms for 512 tokens depending on caching hit rate (we expect 200–220ms range with KV hit ~30%)
- P99: 450–650ms depending on queue depth and fallback ratio
- Sustained throughput: ~40 rps sustained across the pool with burst to 110–130 rps for short windows using autoscale/burst nodes

3) Cost tradeoffs (high level):
- Running 70B quantized continuously: higher cost but best latency profile.
- Mixed approach (70B primary + 13B fallback + caching): ~25–40% cost reduction depending on cache hit and fallback ratio. Exact numbers in attached slo_summary.xlsx.

4) Next steps (proposed):
- Acme to share 30-day QPS + token histogram export (Samantha) 1 target EOD tomorrow
- Redwood to produce final POC runbook + estimate and a short test harness for measuring P95/P99 in your environment — we’ll have a draft by Mon May 18
- Schedule architecture sync — Rachel to propose windows; Marissa will coordinate follow-up

Attaching: slo_summary.xlsx (estimates + test harness outline).

Happy to jump on a call with your infra team to walk this through.

Thanks,
